entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis-Auguste Juvénal des Ursins d'Harville, Count of Harville was a French military officer and politician in late 18th-century France. A Divisional General in the French Revolutionary Wars and the Napoleonic Wars, he was present at the Battle of Jemappes on 6 November 1792 and led the Reserve Division at the subsequent Siege of Namur.
